TITLE: Potential timeline for an Andy Burnham leadership challenge
PUBLISHED: 2026-05-15T15:23Z
AUTHOR: Connor Parker (ITV News multimedia producer)

KEY TIMELINE FACTS:
- By-elections usually take place within 4-6 weeks of an MP resigning from their seat
- By-elections are typically held on Thursdays
- Most likely dates for Makerfield by-election: 18 June or 25 June
- Reform was accepting applicants until Sunday
- The Greens have also said they plan to run in the seat

WIGAN LOCAL ELECTION RESULTS:
- Labour lost all 22 of its councillors in last week's local election
- Reform picked up 24 of the 25 seats up for grabs in Wigan
- In the eight Makerfield wards that voted in the local election: Reform secured 50% of the vote, Labour 23%

LEADERSHIP CHALLENGE TIMELINE:
- If Burnham wins by-election, sworn in as MP the following week
- 20% of party MPs (81 currently) need to back a single replacement candidate to trigger contest
- Closest comparison: race to replace Boris Johnson (resigned 7 July 2022; Liz Truss won contest 5 September 2022 — around two months)
- Several Labour MPs urged Starmer to set timetable for orderly resignation completed by September
- Assuming leadership contest triggered late June/early July: most likely end date late August/early September

"There has never been a direct challenge to the leader of the Labour Party while they are prime minister." (Per ITV)
